name: Post-Purchase Flow (4 Emails)
purpose: Replenishable: make the first order go well, teach them to use it, collect the review, drive the second order. One-off: make them glad they bought, get the review and photo, cross-sell into the next core product.

source.note: Fluid flow system v2, distilled from 31 client strategies (fluid-flow-strategist skill)

profileFilter.description: Placed Order equals 1 over all time (new customers)

actions.job: Personal thank-you from the founder; no offer
subject: Thank you, {{first_name}}
actions.name: Email #1: Thank You + Order Confirmation

all: Thank them for trusting the brand
Set shipping expectations so nobody has to email support
Don't duplicate the store's transactional confirmation
one_off: Offer help with sizing, setup, care or styling
No second-purchase offer yet: reassurance and a good first impression

actions.job: Teach them to use what they bought; second-purchase code held below the teaching
subject: How to get the best results from your {{event.ProductName}}
actions.name: Email #2: How to use it / get the most out of it (+ second-purchase offer)
actions.topic: How to get the best results from your {{event.ProductName}}

replenishable: How to use it for the best result: how much, when, with what, what to expect and when (category version in industries-replenishable.md)
This is the email that protects the reorder: people who use it wrong don't see results
Below the teaching: the second-purchase code; subscription or membership first if the client has it
one_off: The ownership guide for what they bought, per product type: apparel styling/try-on/care/exchanges; jewelry care/sizing/warranty/layering; home installation/placement/care; gear setup/safety/storage/maintenance; digital how-to
Below the guide: the second-purchase code and complementary recommendations from the pairing map (DATA)

actions.job: The check-in only this brand can ask, plus the review ask
subject: How's it going?
actions.name: Email #3: Plain text email from the founder

all: Ask for the review at the moment they've formed an opinion
Invite a reply so problems get caught early
replenishable: "How's it going?" as the specific question only this brand can ask ("Did you finish the can?", "Did the COA check out?")
one_off: The check-in ("How did it go?" after an occasion; "I can't wait for you to wear it")
Ask for a review WITH a photo
Warranty or upgrade reminders where they exist

actions.job: Recommend the next product from what they bought
subject: Picked for you: what goes with your {{event.ProductName}}
actions.name: Email #4: Upsell Offer
actions.topic: Picked for you: what goes with your {{event.ProductName}}
actions.offer: Second-purchase code with a clear expiry

replenishable: Recommend the next product written as a pairing map: Bought X → Y and Z (DATA: product paths)
Subscription, bundle or volume set as the better standing deal
Free-shipping threshold as a basket builder
one_off: Cross-sell into a complementary core product as pairing modules (DATA): e.g. Chain + Bracelet; kayaks → paddles, PFDs, roof racks
Second-purchase code with a clear expiry; any ongoing bundle offer as the alternative
